name: Underpins
description: Foundational dependency — the source is a metaphysical prerequisite for the target

name: Opposes
description: Binary opposition — the source and target are metaphysical contrasts

name: Emerges From
description: Derivative emergence — the source arises from the interaction or synthesis of multiple predecessors

name: Generates
description: Creative hierarchy — the source generates or produces the target

name: Draws From
description: Energy source — the target draws power or essence from the source

name: Biome Affinity
description: Terrain alignment — the source has weighted affinity or influence over the target terrain biome

name: Contains
description: Hierarchical containment — the source is a parent or category of the target

name: Adjacent
description: Spatial transition — the source and target terrains naturally border or transition into each other

name: Amplifies
description: Strengthening synergy — the source enhances or intensifies the effects of the target

name: Suppresses
description: Weakening opposition — the source inhibits or dampens the effects of the target

name: Corrupts
description: Degradation — the source taints, perverts, or corrupts the nature of the target

name: Transforms Into
description: State change — the source transitions or metamorphoses into the target under certain conditions

name: Seasonal Cycle
description: Cyclical rhythm — the source and target alternate in influence or manifestation through time
